sources.reviewed_scope: Selected decisive sections for joint/weight source semantics, not the whole specification or full asset certification.
Selected decisive sections for joint/weight source semantics, not the whole specification or full asset certification.
joints is required, nonempty, unique; schema read, not executed.
mesh/skin and morph weights field relationships; supplementary source read, not full schema execution.

claims.read_finding: Resolve accessor element source then sparse substitution. Semantic checks consume resulting complete elements, not dense source only.
Effective component type combines componentType and normalized; unorm8 c/255 and unorm16 c/65535; float32 and uint32 must not use normalized=true.
attributes map semantic names to accessor indices; JOINTS VEC4 uint8/uint16 discrete, WEIGHTS VEC4 float32/unorm8/unorm16 continuous.
Indexed suffix valid decimal, no leading positive zeros, <=9 digits; each same semantic sequence has no gaps.
Float vertex attributes cannot have NaN/infinity; all primitive attribute accessor counts equal.
Same accessor element corresponds to same logical vertex; an indexed primitive uses one index to select all attributes.
Per-n JOINTS and WEIGHTS both present or absent, VEC4 up to four influences; weights nonnegative; nonzero joint indices unique per vertex; zero-weight placeholders SHOULD be zero.
If all sets unorm8/unorm16 exact total after dequantization MUST be1; implementation note supplies uint8×257 to common denominator65535.

If any float set, total SHOULD be as close as reasonably possible to1; RECOMMENDED epsilon2e-7 times nonzero count. Authoring renormalization and implementations supporting one set distinguished from full preservation.
skin.joints maps skin indices to node indices; optional inverseBindMatrices uses same joint order, but matrix processing is outside proposed method.
Same mesh may be instantiated by nodes with different skins; mapping must be scoped by selected instance skin.
node.skin determines skin for skinning-related primitives; every JOINTS accessor index MUST be < referenced skin.joints length, not only nonzero influences.
Implementation note explains all-zero weights have no applicable transformation; not an ordinary-mesh fallback.
joints required, minItems 1, uniqueItems true; node identifiers are separately resolved before method.

schema_claims.finding: Boolean flag defaults false and cannot be true for FLOAT or UNSIGNED_INT.
count is positive integer; elements, components and bytes must not be confused; basic accessor required fields.

method_design: Keep instance identity, complete paired-set traversal and accessor provenance to produce a traceable influence table.
Retain post-sparse raw unsigned weight components for exact quantized sums; do not certify original integers from rounded inverse conversion.
All zero-weight joint indices are range-checked, while only nonzero influences participate in cross-set uniqueness.
Separate unsupported complete reading, mandatory source errors, recommended FLOAT-sum quality diagnostics and explicit project acceptance.
Bound counts/allocations and integer accumulation; no generator, parser or asset-repair API is claimed.
scope: Core semantics for selected node mesh/skin instance and primitive with skin attributes. Foundation includes parsed structure/reference validity and complete accessor decoding. No matrix, skinning, animation, renderer or full asset certification.
source_independence: Normative sources from one Khronos revision, not multiple independent implementations. Fresh model technical review independently checks decisive sources; paper calculations are not parser execution.
source_discrepancy_boundary: node schema top description says all primitives require JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 when node has skin; main specification 2238–2242 distinguishes primitives with and without skin attributes. This article selects a primitive with the pair and does not use the discrepant sentence to validate other primitives or whole scenes.
